HISTORICAL (pre-PUT, 2026-08-06): the live ruleset had exactly 9 contexts — the 6 retired lanes + Web / lint + Web / test + Web / build. The one-shot PUT deleted the 6 and added the 23 new stage/security contexts; Web / lint|test|build were already required by B1's union step and stayed. The two-step union order was not executable because the 6 retired contexts no longer produce on this PR's head — required checks with no producing lane would leave the merge queue Pending forever (bypass_actors: [] means nobody can clear it either).
Quality / invariants IS required since the PUT (it was NOT before — it is one of the 23 added).

codecov/patch is NOT in the live ruleset (verified post-PUT): the 95% changed-line verdict is not enforced as a status gate. The repo-side patch-coverage policy check lives in pipeline-quality.yml ('Verify patch coverage policy'); it does not make codecov/patch a required check. Re-adding codecov/patch as a real required status is a tracked backlog item in docs/ops/deployment.md.

Context names are GitHub check-run names, not job ids. The 9 security contexts are produced by reusable-security.yml jobs invoked from the ci.yml job named 'Security', so their check-run names are 'Security / <job name>' — verified verbatim against live check-runs on main HEAD (gh api repos/lifeodyssey/animichi/commits/main/check-runs, 2026-08-06): all 9 completed/success.

MERGE-GATE TRAP — SATISFIED: a required context that never produces on merge_group hangs the merge queue. The 9 Security / * contexts run under ci.yml, which declared on.merge_group (branches: [main]) before the PUT, so queue runs produce them. Every pipeline-*.yml lane declares merge_group on main by contract (test_ci_contract.rb enforces the shape).

Catalog startup smoke (bundled boot) is a backlog item, not required (see _deferred_required): the job exists in pipeline-catalog.yml and its check-run is produced unconditionally on PR/merge_group runs, so it can be added by a future PUT without queue risk.
